name: Losses carried forward: share losses against share gains, the general pot against the rest, then the allowance
workings: The salary is taxed as in employee-75k: 13,935.657745
The year: share gain 3,000.00; equity ETF gain 5,000.00 × 70% = 3,500.00 and interest 500.00 in the general pot: 4,000.00
Carried in (inflation factor 1): 4,000.00 of share losses and 2,500.00 of other losses
Share losses offset the share gain: 3,000.00, leaving 1,000.00 of them; other losses offset the rest: 2,500.00 of 4,000.00
Capital income left 1,500.00, less the allowance, which comes after every loss (§20 Abs. 9 Satz 4): 500.00; flat tax 125.00; Soli 6.875
Selling more shares with a 2,000.00 gain: the 1,000.00 of share losses left offset half of it, 26.375% × 1,000.00 = 263.75 (like the gross-up, before the year-end's interest)
